verdict.rationale: The AMD Instinct MI325X is a GPU accelerator, and its software stack (ROCm, HIP, AMD SMI) consists of compilers, runtimes, libraries and CLI tools rather than a hosted web API. A downloadable OpenAPI-style spec is therefore a category error for this kind of product. The evidence shows no first-party HTTP API that would make the axis applicable, and the OpenAPI probe paths on the docs site all returned 404.
